title: Wandering Days
overview: Two years have passed since the events at JuLai. Vash is still missing. Someone is stealing Plants again.

title: Unforgiven
overview: When their home is attacked, Vash is the last hope for Brad, Jessica, and the others.

title: Memento Mori
overview: The immediate threat is suppressed, but now there is no doubt that the threat from Knives is still real.

title: From Order to Chaos
overview: Vash sets off for Home with his companions, but Knives' men are already planning a new attack.

title: What a Wonderful World
overview: Midvalley attacks Home and faces off against Wolfwood.

title: The Darkest Hour Is Just Before the Dawn
overview: Everyone prepares for a huge battle as Legato and the Ark approaches Ship 3.

title: The Hurt Locker
overview: As the arrival of the fleet imminent, both factions begin preparations for the final showdown.

title: Good Bye, My Friend
overview: Wolfwood helps Vash break out of the Ark, but is pursued by Razlo, Livio's alter ego.

title: Reunion
overview: The crew, with its latest new member Livio, regroup at Hopeland to kick off their plan to stop Knives.

title: Martyr
overview: Vash and Knives, and their respective allies, face off in a final showdown at the crash site where it all started.

title: I Miss You.
overview: Knives arrives and captures Vash. His final plan is set in motion - as well as Vash's final resistance.

title: QUO VADIS
overview: The immigrant fleet arrives, and Knives single-handedly threatens to eliminate them.
